card.situation:
Central Plant Computer System (CPCS) Maintenance solicitation (FA255026R0026) at Schriever Space Force Base, CO — Total Small Business Set-Aside, period of performance 1 Sep 2026 – 1 Mar 2032 (~66 months).
Reached the owner because the firm is SBA-eligible, holds an exact NAICS 541512 match, has two active federal past-performance records, and 22 Secret-cleared staff; fit score 0.7895 against 38 validated requirements.
reasons_for: Firm is eligible under the Total Small Business Set-Aside with active SAM registration and exact NAICS 541512 match, clearing the threshold gate [475ec029-0be6051f-p3-05e3cca6].
Twenty-two Secret-cleared staff make base-access and site-visit requirements achievable with no administrative barrier [475ec029-0be6051f-p5-ac02b98d].
Two active federal contracts (~$3.75M combined) support a credible statement of financial responsibility and WAWF/FAR compliance [475ec029-descript-p0-e7d2176a].
reasons_against: Core scope is CPCS/building-automation maintenance (BAS/SCADA/industrial controls); neither past-performance record involves plant-control systems, leaving the technical evaluation factor critically exposed [475ec029-49e8eb1a-p21-333bafaf].

Firm is based in Norman, OK with no stated Colorado office or on-site staffing capability, creating a sustained-presence risk across a 66-month period of performance at Schriever SFB [475ec029-49e8eb1a-p14-32023d56].

The PWS is not publicly available and the questions deadline has already passed (days-to-close: −10.8), so the firm cannot clarify hidden technical requirements before the 3 Sep 2026 proposal due date [475ec029-descript-p0-df3d5ab8].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC — Capability Statement
Submitted in response to FA255026R0026, Central Plant Computer System (CPCS) Maintenance, Schriever Space Force Base, CO

Sooner Systems LLC is a Small Business Administration-registered small business with an exact NAICS 541512 match to this solicitation. We are eligible to compete under the Total Small Business Set-Aside and hold an active SAM registration.

Our workforce includes 22 personnel holding Secret-level clearances, supporting base-access requirements at Schriever SFB without administrative delay. We maintain a 24×7 network operations center (NOC) capability and have demonstrated sustained performance on federal IT contracts.

Past Performance:
• IT Help Desk and Desktop Support — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Tulsa District | NAICS 541512 | ~$2.1M | 2022–2025. Delivered Tier 1/Tier 2 service desk, end-user support, and ITIL-aligned ticketing operations.
• Network Administration and Cybersecurity Support — FAA Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center | NAICS 541519 | ~$1.65M | 2021–2024. Provided RMF/ATO support, vulnerability management (ACAS/STIG), SIEM/SOAR operations, and ISSO services in a federal aviation environment.

Combined past federal contract value: approximately $3.75M. Both contracts were performed on schedule and within budget.

Sooner Systems LLC is prepared to provide a statement of financial responsibility, complete the CLIN pricing schedule, and submit a full technical proposal by the 3 September 2026 deadline.

Point of Contact: [Name], [Title]
Phone: [Phone] | Email: [Email]
SAM UEI: [UEI] | CAGE: [CAGE]
questions_for_co: The Performance Work Statement (PWS) is available only via DoD SAFE request. Can the PWS be provided immediately, and what is the turnaround time for DoD SAFE distribution, given the proposal deadline of 3 September 2026? [475ec029-descript-p0-df3d5ab8]

Can the government specify what equipment, tools, or facilities are minimally required to satisfy this determination for the CPCS scope at Schriever SFB? [475ec029-descript-p0-b9b8d338]

Does the government require past performance specifically in Central Plant Computer System, building automation system (BAS), SCADA, or industrial control system maintenance, or will relevant IT systems maintenance and federal contract experience be considered comparable? [475ec029-0be6051f-p4-53d5d696]

Will the government accept a teaming arrangement or subcontracting plan that brings CPCS-specific technical expertise, and if so, what documentation is required to demonstrate the subcontractor's qualifications in the proposal? [475ec029-descript-p0-75ebb9de]

Is on-site presence at Schriever SFB required on a daily or scheduled basis throughout the period of performance, or is the work primarily response-based with defined response-time windows specified in the PWS? [475ec029-49e8eb1a-p14-32023d56]

The full description of services is contained in a Performance Work Statement (PWS) available via DoD SAFE upon request from the contracting officer.

Active SAM registration is required for award eligibility.
